design: 96 heldout copy prompts; final-position normalized MLP input edits at layers10-17;7 modes x fixed amplitudes0.25/0.5/1 plus native. Add frozen shifts to actual evolving MLP inputs, without renormalizing. Exact-delta uses donor-native minus copy-native contexts; exact-clamp interpolates actual evolving context toward donor-native context. Compare KL(task||edited), target CE, candidate and exact top1 separately. All original item splits retained.
limitations: Finite activation edits differ from derivative operator replacement. Exact controls use heldout donor activations; means use discovery only. No amplitude selection or behavioral optimization. Natural task prompt can be incorrect. Edit does not replace earlier processing or attention.
